content.headline: Full-stack engineer for products that are already live.
content.intro: I've spent 2+ years shipping inside real SaaS and mobile products: a payment system for five providers, embeddable forms that turn visitors into clients, real-time chat and video calls, and a music-streaming app I built solo in React Native.

notes: ClientManager is a production SaaS, live with real users
Agencies, freelancers and businesses run their whole client lifecycle on it
My work sits where mistakes cost money or trust: payments, access and live data
intro.annotation: Most of my work is inside products people already pay for. That changes how carefully you build.

rows.title: Payments & invoicing
rows.line: One payment system for Stripe, PayPal, Square, Authorize.Net, and Venmo. Invoices, recurring billing, and “paid” that’s marked exactly once.

figure.caption: payment providers behind one payment system

points: Invoices, templates and recurring billing in ClientManager
Stripe mobile payments tied to listening packages in Blarecast
Stripe subscriptions in Your Business Date

rows.title: Forms, bookings & checkout
rows.line: Embeddable forms that capture leads, book meetings across time zones, and sell services, straight into the CRM.

figure.caption: form types built end to end: contact, booking and service

points: An embed loader that puts the forms on any website
Quick Hire checkout for selling services
Every entry goes straight into the CRM

rows.title: Real-time features
rows.line: Live chat with Socket.io; audio and video calls with Agora; live updates in dashboards.

points: My first real-time chat: read state, file, image and document sharing, and emoji
Agora audio and video calls, made stable by working through tokens, channel sync and SDK events

rows.title: Auth, roles & access
rows.line: JWT, role-based permissions, Google and Apple sign-in that works in production, not just locally.

points: Google sign-in broke only in production. I fixed it by lining up the OAuth credentials, Supabase, Expo redirect URLs and build settings

rows.title: Mobile apps
rows.line: React Native + Expo: background audio, offline downloads, queue and playback control.

figure.caption: to learn React Native, then I built Blarecast alone

points: Playback on React Native Track Player: queue, shuffle, loop and background play
Offline downloads, AI playlists and Google Cast

rows.title: AI agents
